label: Airtable
description: Sync orders, line items, customers, products, variants, subscriptions, coupons and categories to an Airtable base. Create a personal access token at airtable.com/create/tokens with scopes data.records:read, data.records:write, schema.bases:read and schema.bases:write, and give it access to your base. Then run "Create tables & columns" from the Actions menu of this page, and "Backfill all synced collections" under Airtable in the dashboard sidebar.

actions.label: Connection test
actions.hint: Checks the token, the base, the tables and every column and its type

modal.description: Creates the tables of the synced collections and adds missing columns. Tables you made yourself keep their rows and extra columns.

fields.label: Replace columns with the wrong type
fields.description: Renames columns whose type the app can't write into to "<name> (old)", keeping their data, and creates them again with the right type. Run a backfill afterwards to fill them.

fields.label: Personal access token
fields.description: From airtable.com/create/tokens. Needs data.records:read and data.records:write; add schema.bases:read and schema.bases:write to let the app check and create tables.

fields.label: Base ID
fields.description: Starts with "app". It's the part after airtable.com/ in the base's URL.

fields.label: Write Airtable edits back to Swell

options.label: Products: name, SKU, active, price, on sale, sale price, track stock, stock level
Product variants: name, SKU, active, price, on sale, sale price, stock level
Customers: email, first name, last name, phone, email opt-in
Coupons: name, active, use limit, valid from, expires

fields.description: Edits to these columns in Airtable are written to Swell within about a minute. The collection must also be synced. Changing a stock level adds a stock adjustment for the difference. Other columns stay read-only: edits to them are overwritten by the next Swell change. New rows and deleted rows in Airtable are not copied to Swell.

fields.label: When a record is deleted in Swell
Backfill page size
fields.description: Records (or order line items) sent per backfill step (1-100). Steps that hit Airtable's rate limit wait and retry automatically; lower the size if that happens often.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Turns off all syncing without uninstalling the app
